feeding_claim.verbatim: Today, we operate on over 400 acres of land producing corn silage and hay for our livestock feed.

resold_note: Also sells soap from Bubbly Duck Soap Company.
notes: Family farm founded in 1914, now hay and livestock on over 400 acres. Checked 2026-11-15: homepage, about and products pages. The site calls the beef grass-fed and pasture-raised and says animals get as much pasture as possible, but the about page says the farm grows corn silage and hay for its livestock feed, so the diet is mixed and the category is percentage. The about page says the store sells beef and lamb from the farm; lamb is from Karen's Lambs, the family's sheep and goat side of the farm. The products page says the store carries chicken and goose eggs seasonally without saying the farm keeps the hens, so eggs are left out. Farm market in Watertown (recent posted hours Fri 3 to 6, Sat 10 to 3, Sun 10 to 1) and an online store on Barn2Door. The farm's own posts on the homepage show stands at the Kent, Black Rock, Greenwich and Blueback farmers markets (and Newtown). No phone, bulk shares, delivery or shipping stated. Also sells honey, maple syrup, fiber goods and hay.
